docs.title: What is Java?
docs.text:
Java is a high-level, object-oriented, platform-independent programming language developed by Sun Microsystems (now owned by Oracle).

It is designed to be: - Simple - Secure - Robust - Portable

Java follows the principle: "Write Once, Run Anywhere (WORA)"

docs.title: Why Learn Java?
docs.text:
Java is one of the most in-demand programming languages.

It is widely used in: - Web applications - Android mobile apps - Enterprise systems - Automation testing (Selenium, TestNG)

✔ Beginner-friendly ✔ Huge community support ✔ Used in real-world projects

docs.title: Platform Independent
docs.text: Java code can run on any system that has JVM installed.

docs.title: Object-Oriented
docs.text: Everything in Java is based on objects and classes.

docs.title: Secure
docs.text: Java does not use pointers and has built-in security features.

docs.title: Robust
docs.text: Strong memory management and exception handling.

docs.title: Multithreaded
docs.text: Java supports running multiple tasks at the same time.

docs.title: Java Architecture (VERY IMPORTANT)
docs.text: Java works using three main components:

docs.title: 1. JVM (Java Virtual Machine)
docs.text:
JVM is the engine that runs Java programs.

Responsibilities: - Executes bytecode - Converts bytecode into machine code - Manages memory - Handles garbage collection

✔ Platform dependent ✔ Core of Java runtime

docs.title: 2. JRE (Java Runtime Environment)
docs.text:
JRE provides the environment to run Java programs.

It includes: - JVM - Libraries - Runtime files

✔ Used only for running Java programs

docs.title: 3. JDK (Java Development Kit)
docs.text:
JDK is used for developing Java applications.

It includes: - JRE - Compiler (javac) - Tools (debugger, etc.)

✔ Used for writing + compiling + running

docs.title: Relationship
docs.text:
JDK = JRE + Development Tools
JRE = JVM + Libraries
